skill.name: sequenzy-email-marketing
skill.description: Guide agents through Sequenzy email marketing workflows, including subscribers, campaigns, sequences, templates, webhooks, stats, and credential handling.
skill.summary: Operate Sequenzy email marketing tasks through documented CLI and MCP workflows.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code spans, service URL examples, environment variable names, and defensive secret-handling guidance. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or unauthorized endpoint instructions were found, but the skill has operational risk because it guides authenticated Sequenzy mutations.

remediation.issue: Destructive commands can run with skipped interactive confirmation in agent or CI contexts.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit user confirmation step in the skill text before delete, cancel, invite, webhook, or send-related mutations, even when --yes is technically required.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on sensitive API keys and one-time webhook secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the redaction guidance and state that secrets must never be written to project files unless the user selects that storage destination.

remediation.issue: The skill supports high-impact campaign and subscriber changes.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short preflight checklist for target company, resource ID, audience size, and dashboard preview before scheduling or destructive operations.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive Sequenzy Actions Can Bypass Interactive Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells agents to pass --yes for destructive commands in non-TTY runs and documents campaign cancellation as a no-confirmation action. Mistaken IDs or ambiguous user requests could delete or alter Sequenzy resources before human review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines explicitly document skipped confirmation behavior for destructive or urgent campaign actions. The risk is operational misuse rather than malware, so medium severity is appropriate.

content.value_statement: Email marketing agents need precise commands and safeguards for account changes. This skill maps Sequenzy requests to supported CLI and MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Checks Sequenzy authentication state with login, whoami, account, and API key guidance.
Manages subscribers, lists, tags, saved segments, and bulk list imports.
Creates, updates, schedules, tests, pauses, resumes, cancels, duplicates, and deletes campaigns.
Builds templates and sequences, including enrollment, cancellation, branches, and discount steps.
Handles webhooks, inbox conversations, team invitations, product delivery files, and dashboard URLs.
Generates draft emails, sequences, subject lines, and delivery performance reports.
limitations: Requires the Sequenzy CLI or MCP tools and valid Sequenzy credentials.
Campaign immediate send is not wired; users must schedule a near-future send instead.
Generated copy is draft content and needs review before sending.
Some product trigger filters and unsupported workflows must be completed in the dashboard.

use_cases.title: Run Campaign Operations
use_cases.description: Create drafts, update content, schedule sends, manage A/B tests, and stop campaigns when needed.

use_cases.title: Maintain Subscriber Data
use_cases.description: Import contacts, manage lists and tags, build segments, and inspect subscriber activity before changes.

use_cases.title: Automate Product Delivery
use_cases.description: Attach product files, create purchase-triggered sequences, configure webhooks, and send transactional email.

prompt_templates.title: Check Account Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $sequenzy-email-marketing to check whether this machine is authenticated and show the current Sequenzy account context.

prompt_templates.title: Create Campaign Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $sequenzy-email-marketing to create a draft campaign for [audience] about [offer]. Return the review URL and do not schedule it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Import And Segment Subscribers
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $sequenzy-email-marketing to import subscribers from [file], add them to [list], apply [tag], and report the import counts.

prompt_templates.title: Build Product Delivery Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $sequenzy-email-marketing to sync products, attach [file] to [product], create a purchase-triggered delivery sequence, and provide the editor URL.

output_examples.input: Check delivery performance for the last 30 days.
output_examples.output: The account delivery stats were retrieved for the 30 day period. The response highlights sent, delivered, opened, clicked, unsubscribed, open rate, and click rate values.

output_examples.input: Create a launch campaign draft and let me review it.
output_examples.output: A draft campaign was created with generated email content. The response includes the campaign ID, review URL, and a note that scheduling still needs approval.

output_examples.input: Invite a teammate with billing visibility only.
output_examples.output: The workflow chooses viewer access with billing access, then explains that only the company owner can grant billing access.

best_practices: Inspect account, company, IDs, and current status before mutating Sequenzy resources.
Redact API keys and webhook signing secrets, and save them only to user-approved secure storage.
Review generated copy, audience targeting, and dashboard previews before scheduling or sending.
anti_patterns: Running destructive actions before confirming the target ID and expected impact.
Looping over single subscriber commands instead of using bulk list import commands.
Treating AI-generated campaign or sequence copy as ready to send without review.

faq.question: Does this skill send email by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides Sequenzy CLI or MCP workflows, and sending still requires credentials and an explicit user request.

faq.question: Can it create and schedule campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports draft creation, updates, testing, scheduling, lifecycle controls, and dashboard review links.

faq.question: Can it manage subscribers in bulk?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses list import and add-subscribers workflows for CSV, newline, or supported JSON inputs.

faq.question: How are API keys and webhook secrets handled?
faq.answer: The skill tells agents to treat them as sensitive, avoid chat logs, and store them only in approved secure locations.

faq.question: Does it support immediate campaign sending?
faq.answer: No. The documented CLI path schedules campaigns, including near-future scheduling when immediate send is requested.

faq.question: Can it replace the Sequenzy dashboard?
faq.answer: No. Some workflows require dashboard review, unsupported API paths, or manual configuration.
